device.name: Xiaomi 17 Ultra
device.identity_status: nezha confirmed through read-only ADB on 2026-08-27; modified-ROM properties are not immutable hardware proof

references.name: evolution-manifest
references.purpose: Official Evolution X Android 16 platform manifest; individual projects remain branch-based until a resolved manifest is saved.

references.name: evolution-vendor
references.purpose: Evolution X product configuration, installed as vendor/lineage by the platform manifest.

references.name: extract-utils
references.purpose: Upstream tools for generating proprietary vendor trees from legally obtained stock firmware.

references.name: hardware-xiaomi
references.purpose: Xiaomi hardware integration reference, not proof of SM8850 or nezha compatibility.

references.name: nezha-device-reference
references.purpose: INCOMPLETE community reference: missing lineage_nezha.mk and vendor/kernel dependencies, stale popsicle identity. Never installed into the platform checkout automatically.

references.name: sm8850-common-reference
references.purpose: Other-device reference only: myron configuration, unverified nezha layout, AVB test settings. Not an active dependency.

references.name: miuicamera-packaging-reference
references.purpose: Evolution X camera packaging example for Peridot only: permissions, overlays and proprietary dependency categories. Not compatible with nezha by assumption.

references.name: micode-index
references.purpose: Official Xiaomi kernel release index snapshot; no confirmed Xiaomi 17 Ultra release in this index.

references.name: micode-popsicle-kernel
references.purpose: Official shared SM8850 kernel/vendor layer cited by the later community Nezha ROM. Its ACK, KMI and compiler family are relevant; it is not a complete or verified Nezha kernel build. Reference only.

references.name: micode-popsicle-devicetree
references.purpose: Official sibling SM8850 device-tree reference. Inspected Popsicle/Pudding/Pandora Xiaomi board IDs differ from the extracted Nezha overlay; never substitute their board configuration automatically.

references.name: aosp-mkbootimg
references.purpose: Official Android 16 boot-image parser for offline inspection only; no firmware installer is executed.

references.name: aosp-avb
references.purpose: Official Android 16 avbtool for read-only image metadata and signature/digest inspection; not an authorization to sign or modify images.

references.name: aosp-libufdt
references.purpose: Official Android 16 mkdtboimg parser for offline DTBO table inspection; no device tree from another phone is adopted.

references.name: repo-tool
references.purpose: Official Google repo launcher and implementation, pinned to the observed stable commit.
